limits.blatant: The planted defects are blatant. The numbers show the checks catch such text, not how often the writer produces it.
limits.oneApartment: All six sets are variations of one synthetic apartment: evidence that the mechanism works, not a catch rate for real listings.
limits.freeform: Conflicts about free-form details, such as a floor material, are found by the model on a best-effort basis.
limits.audio: The audit reads facts and quotes, not audio. The script says “L-vormige”, the transcript “ellipsvormige”, the copy “elliptical”: you catch that at review 2.
